text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Selfish girls just cause trouble for 
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since they sacrificed so much to send me 
off, I wanted to live up to it. I had to 
work hard so not even a single second 
would go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Because I love my family with all my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I was terrified that my little sisters 
would think, 'It's always all about Big 
Sis.' I was so scared that the family bond 
we'd built up until now would shatter."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I assumed all on my own that I had to at 
least help my family as a reliable "big 
sister." That I had to support this warm, 
happy home.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not as big a deal as I made myself 
out to be in my head. I'm still just... 
"me"—)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Showered in so much love by my family, 
and receiving such warmth from everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm Ines Fujin, the one who's right 
here, enjoying racing like this."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahhh... What an incredible 
cheer...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It feels so gooooood...!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If running at 100% like that is who I 
am—)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(――I want to spread my arms as wide as I 
can, and take in everyone's feelings with 
all my might.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Traineeer~! So about the next 
goal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Takarazuka Kinen!

A Spring Grand Prix held in June, 
featuring fan-favorite Umamusume. A 2,200m 
turf GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You need popularity with the fans to run 
in the Grand Prix, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought... Maybe running in 
the Takarazuka Kinen is the same as 
carrying everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There might not be as many people dreaming 
big dreams for me compared to other girls, 
but still.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I want to answer those dreams 
on the grand stage. I want to carry them 
properly."

Drawn in by her overflowing motivation, I 
began picturing the potential contenders 
for this year's Takarazuka Kinen.
choice_data_list:
Then we'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and 
the others too.

Then we'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and 
the others too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? To Ryan-chan and the others too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
How do you know both of them will run in 
the Takarazuka Kinen? The spring GⅠ races 
have only just begun, haven't they?
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because you're an Umamusume 
everyone expects great things from.

text_block_list.text:
Lately, the public's attention on Mejiro 
Ryan and Mejiro McQueen had grown 
immensely.

What does it mean to be perfect? Mejiro 
McQueen, who has claimed victory after 
victory with overwhelming strength, 
dominating from the front of the pack.

On the other hand, even in the face of 
adversity, Mejiro Ryan's unwavering, 
stalwart back showed the resolve befitting 
a prestigious house, earning her immense 
popularity.

The two of them are truly indispensable 
figures in the Umamusume world today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why the two of them will definitely 
run. ...Because they're indispensable to 
this dream race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa...! Is that so...! I'm totally 
useless at it~~...!!
choice_data_list:
Aines is being counted on too, just like 
those two!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Thanks for covering for me, but 
...even I know that was pretty bad just 
now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I've been thinking only about 
myself, and I really haven't been paying 
attention to the world around me. That's 
what I ended up realizing."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Was I too caught up in myself? Something 
like that. I need to broaden my horizons 
and reflect on this.
choice_data_list:
Still, being passionate about something 
isn't a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer, you always jump in to back 
me up like that!

However, in truth, providing support is a 
Trainer's duty. Besides—
choice_data_list:
Because I want Ines to stay focused purely 
on her running.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~...? I think you're already plenty 
obsessed as it is...?

Watching her scratch her cheek, I recalled 
the conversations I'd had with the people 
who had interacted with her up until now.

My feelings had always been the exact same 
as theirs.
choice_data_list:
(I just want her to enjoy running with 
everything she's got.)

text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, as her Trainer, I must 
continue supporting her! The next goal is 
the Takarazuka Kinen!"
